description.value: Premiere Suites Victoria is an extended-stay furnished apartment property aimed at corporate and relocation guests needing stays of 30 nights or more. Located on Johnson Street in downtown Victoria, it is part of the national Premiere Suites Alliance network of 10,000+ furnished suites across Canada. A touring cyclist staying here would have access to a fully equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, and a dedicated workspace in a residential-style setting.
